extracted.name: Mulled beer
extracted.description: Get into the festive spirit with mulled beer, made with golden ale, apple juice, brandy and warming spices. Serve warm in heatproof glasses or mugs
instruction_lines: Tip the ale, apple juice, cinnamon sticks, star anise, cloves, light brown soft sugar and orange into a pan set over a medium heat and warm through until steaming – don’t let it boil.
Taste and add more brown sugar if you like. Remove from the heat and stir in the brandy, then serve in heatproof glasses or mugs.
